verdict.rationale: Proa compiles components with signals and event handlers into server-rendered HTML plus a generated vanilla-JS module per island, served with a shared runtime of about 1.3 KB gzipped. Its template macro also does compile-time validation and static-markup consolidation. Together these suggest compiler-generated client updates rather than hand-written diffing, but nothing documents fine-grained or surgical DOM patching specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how compiled islands update the DOM (fine-grained or surgical vs. diffing), coverage beyond island-scoped interactivity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of update efficiency.
